+        inherit an earlier run's checkpoint.enabled."""
+        from primus.backends.automodel.models.ideogram4 import zero1
+
+        set_option("primus_ideogram4.zero1", True)
+        install_stub_optimizer_hierarchy(monkeypatch)
+        zero1.install(checkpoint_enabled=True)
+        set_option("primus_ideogram4.zero1", False)
+
+        assert zero1.install(checkpoint_enabled=False) is False
+        assert zero1._checkpointing_enabled is False
+
+
+class TestGating:
+    def test_off_by_default(self, monkeypatch):
+        """Not set: install does nothing and reports it."""
+        module = install_stub_optimizer_hierarchy(monkeypatch)
+        before = vars(module.FactoryConfig)["build"]
+
+        from primus.backends.automodel.models.ideogram4 import zero1
+
+        assert zero1.install() is False
+        assert vars(module.FactoryConfig)["build"] is before
+
+    def test_switching_off_after_install_is_inert(self, zero1_installed, monkeypatch, set_option):
+        """The switch is re-read at call time, not captured at install time, so the
+        installed wrapper cannot outlive the request for it."""
+        builds = install_fake_zero(monkeypatch)
+        set_option("primus_ideogram4.zero1", False)
+
+        result = zero1_installed.OptimizerConfig().build([1, 2])
+
+        assert builds == []
+        assert isinstance(result[0], FakeOptimizer)
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [True, 1, "true", "True", "yes", "on"])
+    def test_accepted_spellings(self, set_option, value):
+        set_option("primus_ideogram4.zero1", value)
+        from primus.backends.automodel.models.ideogram4 import zero1
+
+        assert zero1.is_zero1_enabled() is True
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [False, 0, "false", "off", "no"])
+    def test_rejected_spellings(self, set_option, value):
+        set_option("primus_ideogram4.zero1", value)
+        from primus.backends.automodel.models.ideogram4 import zero1
+
+        assert zero1.is_zero1_enabled() is False
+
+    # (value, whether AutoModel saves): absent is its default of true; a string is
+    # read as its config loader reads it, so "off" and "no" stay truthy strings.
+    CHECKPOINT_VALUES = [
+        ("<absent>", True),
+        (False, False),
+        (True, True),
+        ("false", False),
+        ("False", False),
+        ("0", False),
+        (0, False),
+        ("None", False),
+        ("true", True),
+        ("1", True),
+        ("off", True),
+        ("no", True),
+    ]
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("value, saves", CHECKPOINT_VALUES)
+    def test_the_patch_reads_checkpoint_enabled_as_automodel_does(
+        self, monkeypatch, set_option, value, saves
+    ):
+        """bool() alone would turn the string "false" into true and refuse a run
+        that does not save; a Primus-style parse would turn "off" into false and let
+        through a run that AutoModel does save, which fails at the first save."""
+        import types
+
+        import primus.backends.automodel.patches  # noqa: F401

inline_comments.body: The FSDP2 parameters are not guaranteed to be `DTensor` objects themselves: after `fully_shard`, the optimizer commonly receives `nn.Parameter` wrappers whose `p.data` is the `DTensor` (the repository's FSDP2 optimizer handles this explicitly at `primus/backends/megatron/core/optimizer/fsdp2_bf16_master_weight_optimizer.py:127`). Checking only `isinstance(p, dtensor)` therefore lets `primus_ideogram4.zero1` proceed on an FSDP2 optimizer instead of taking the documented no-op path, so it can try to construct ZeRO-1 over already-sharded parameters. Check both the parameter and its data before wrapping.

+###############################################################################
+# Copyright (c) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+#
+# See LICENSE for license information.
+###############################################################################
+"""ZeRO-1 optimizer sharding for DDP runs.
+
+WHY:
+  Pure DDP replicates parameters and gradients, so there is no per-layer
+  all-gather -- but it also replicates the optimizer state, which for AdamW is
+  two more copies of the parameters, in the parameters' dtype. ZeRO-1 shards only
+  that state across the data-parallel ranks, keeping DDP's compute profile.
+
+  Per-layer compilation is wired only into the FSDP2 path, so on a single node
+  DDP with ZeRO-1 gives up compilation for collectives that were a small part of
+  the step anyway. It is the multi-node lever; on one node, hybrid sharding (a
+  data-parallel replicate dimension above one) sheds traffic and keeps compile.
+
+WHAT (NO AutoModel fork):
+  Wraps the optimizers the recipe builds in torch's ZeroRedundancyOptimizer. The
+  subtle part is which classes to patch; see ``_optimizer_config_classes``.
+
+  Activation checkpointing on the DDP path is not handled here: the Ideogram-4
+  sidecar checkpoints blocks on every strategy, and the DDP flag repair forwards
+  the setting upstream's parser drops.
+
+Opt in with ``primus_ideogram4.zero1: true`` in the module config.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import functools
+import inspect
+import logging
+
+from primus.backends.automodel import options
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+_LOG_PREFIX = "[PrimusIdeogramZeRO1]"
+
+# AutoModel saves the optimizer through its state_dict, which an unconsolidated
+# ZeroRedundancyOptimizer refuses on every rank, so the first save would crash.
+_checkpointing_enabled = False
+
+
+def is_zero1_enabled() -> bool:
+    """Whether to shard the optimizer state."""
+    return options.flag("primus_ideogram4.zero1")
+
+
+def _dtensor_class():
+    """torch's DTensor, or None on a torch without one."""
+    try:
+        from torch.distributed.tensor import DTensor
+    except ImportError:
+        try:
+            from torch.distributed._tensor import DTensor
+        except ImportError:
+            return None
+    return DTensor
+
+
+def _params_are_dtensor(params) -> bool:
+    """Whether these parameters are already sharded, i.e. this is an FSDP run."""
+    dtensor = _dtensor_class()
+    return dtensor is not None and any(isinstance(p, dtensor) for p in params)

+# AutoModel pre_trainer module config — Ideogram-4 pretrain on a REAL
+# pre-encoded cache (Primus backend: automodel).
+#
+# The `ideogram4_pre_trainer.yaml` preset with `data.dataloader` reading a cache of
+# encoded image/caption pairs instead of synthetic features. Build the cache with:
+#
+#   bash ./runner/primus-cli direct --single -- data automodel-cache --model ideogram4 \
+#       --image-dir /path/to/images --caption-dir /path/to/captions \
+#       --output-dir /path/to/cache
+#
+# and point data.dataloader.cache_dir at /path/to/cache. --help lists the options.
+#
+# A separate preset because the two dataloaders take different fields, and an
+# override would let synthetic-only keys survive the deep-merge.
+#
+# NOTE: do not declare a `model:` block here — it comes from the model preset.
+extends:
+  - ../module_base.yaml
+
+seed: 42
+
+wandb:
+  enable: false
+
+dist_env:
+  backend: nccl
+  timeout_minutes: 30
+
+step_scheduler:
+  global_batch_size: 16
+  local_batch_size: 2
+  ckpt_every_steps: 1000
+  num_epochs: 1000
+  log_remote_every_steps: 1
+  save_checkpoint_every_epoch: false
+
+data:
+  dataloader:
+    _target_: primus.backends.automodel.models.ideogram4.data.cache.Ideogram4CacheDataloaderConfig
+    # PLACEHOLDER: a cache directory built by the command above. Override per run.
+    cache_dir: /path/to/ideogram4_cache
+    shuffle: true
+    drop_last: true
+    # Pad the text region to a constant width, so the packed sequence length does
+    # not change between steps -- per-batch padding recompiles the graph on nearly
+    # every one. 0 derives the width from the cache's longest caption; a positive
+    # value sets it explicitly and must be at least that long, since a caption is
+    # never truncated; -1 restores per-batch padding.
+    max_text_tokens: 0
+    num_workers: 2
+    pin_memory: true
+
+optimizer:
+  _target_: torch.optim.AdamW
+  lr: 1e-4
+  weight_decay: 0.01
+  betas: [0.9, 0.999]
+  # fused AdamW (mutually exclusive with foreach).
+  foreach: false
+  fused: true
+
+performance:
+  check_loss: false
+  grad_clip_foreach: true
+
+lr_scheduler:
+  lr_decay_style: cosine
+  lr_warmup_steps: 0
+  min_lr: 1e-6
+
+flow_matching:
+  adapter_type: ideogram4
+  adapter_kwargs:
+    in_channels: 128
+    predict_negative_velocity: true
+  timestep_sampling: logit_normal
+  logit_mean: 0.0
+  logit_std: 1.0
+  flow_shift: 3.0
+  mix_uniform_ratio: 0.1
+  # No classifier-free-guidance dropout, which keeps the loss signal clean while
+  # validating the data path. A real pretrain should raise this to train the
+  # unconditional branch.
+  cfg_dropout_prob: 0.0

+#   - data.dataloader -> synthetic pre-encoded latents and text features; use
+#     `ideogram4_cache_pre_trainer.yaml` for a real encoded cache.
+#   - flow_matching.adapter_type -> ideogram4, the adapter that packs the
+#     [pad][text][image] sequence and negates the predicted velocity.
+#

+extends:
+  - ../module_base.yaml
+
+seed: 42
+
+wandb:

inline_comments.body: This one is already handled: FSDP2's parameters are DTensors themselves. When `fully_shard` wraps a sharded DTensor in `nn.Parameter`, `Parameter.__new__` doesn't create a plain Parameter around it, because that's only done for plain tensors. For a tensor subclass it returns the subclass instance with `_is_param` set, so `isinstance(p, DTensor)` holds for every sharded parameter, and `p.data` is that same DTensor. The Megatron optimizer's `isinstance(p.data, DTensor)` is therefore the same test written the other way round. It's also confirmed on hardware: in the FSDP2 run on MI355X, ZeRO-1 took this path, warned that the parameters are already sharded and kept the plain optimizer. So I've left the check as it is.

+###############################################################################

+"""ZeRO-1 optimizer sharding for DDP runs.
+
+WHY:
+  Pure DDP replicates parameters and gradients, so there is no per-layer
+  all-gather -- but it also replicates the optimizer state, which for AdamW is
+  two more copies of the parameters, in the parameters' dtype. ZeRO-1 shards only
+  that state across the data-parallel ranks, keeping DDP's compute profile.
+
+  Per-layer compilation is wired only into the FSDP2 path, so on a single node
+  DDP with ZeRO-1 gives up compilation for collectives that were a small part of
+  the step anyway. It is the multi-node lever; on one node, hybrid sharding (a
+  data-parallel replicate dimension above one) sheds traffic and keeps compile.
+
+WHAT (NO AutoModel fork):
+  Wraps the optimizers the recipe builds in torch's ZeroRedundancyOptimizer. The
+  subtle part is which classes to patch; see ``_optimizer_config_classes``.
+
+  Activation checkpointing on the DDP path is not handled here: the Ideogram-4
+  sidecar checkpoints blocks on every strategy, and the DDP flag repair forwards
+  the setting upstream's parser drops.
+
+Opt in with ``primus_ideogram4.zero1: true`` in the module config.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import functools
+import inspect
+import logging
+
+from primus.backends.automodel import options
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+_LOG_PREFIX = "[PrimusIdeogramZeRO1]"
+
+# AutoModel saves the optimizer through its state_dict, which an unconsolidated
+# ZeroRedundancyOptimizer refuses on every rank, so the first save would crash.
+_checkpointing_enabled = False
+
+
+def is_zero1_enabled() -> bool:
+    """Whether to shard the optimizer state."""
+    return options.flag("primus_ideogram4.zero1")
+
+
+def _dtensor_class():
+    """torch's DTensor, or None on a torch without one."""
+    try:
+        from torch.distributed.tensor import DTensor
+    except ImportError:
+        try:
+            from torch.distributed._tensor import DTensor
+        except ImportError:
+            return None
+    return DTensor
+
+
+def _params_are_dtensor(params) -> bool:
+    """Whether these parameters are already sharded, i.e. this is an FSDP run."""
+    dtensor = _dtensor_class()
+    return dtensor is not None and any(isinstance(p, dtensor) for p in params)
